name: In-Scattering Approximation
definition: A cheap approximation for in-scattering that accounts for phase function and depth into the cloud using a remapped exponential decay, avoiding expensive integration.
summary: In-Scattering Approximation is a computationally cheap, non-iterative method that estimates short-range scattering by treating scattered light as an emittance source, avoiding expensive integration through analytical per-sample computation.
